title: MobX Stores — ProjectStore, UIStore, StoreProvider
description: Create the MobX state management layer: ProjectStore manages the layer tree (add, remove, reorder, rename, toggle visibility), project metadata, and serialization. UIStore manages UI state (selected layer, panel visibility, active tool). Create a StoreProvider React context that provides all stores to the component tree. Create barrel index.ts for store exports.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectStore: MobX observable layer tree with add/remove/reorder/rename/toggleVisibility actions
ProjectStore: project metadata (name, dimensions, createdAt, modifiedAt)
StoreProvider creates and provides all stores via React context
useStore() hook for consuming stores in components
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
completion_summary: Created ProjectStore (layer tree CRUD, shader components, serialization), UIStore (selection, panels, prompt modes), stores barrel, and StoreProvider with hooks
